context_for_next_agent: CLOSES the arc 20260813-0702 -> 20260814-0542 -> 20260814-0649. The booking feature is IN PRODUCTION. PR #189 squash-merged to main as 84ec230 with every CI check green; branch deleted. CD run 31816870153 then migrated Supabase and redeployed Koyeb, smoke check passed. Verified directly against PROD afterwards: `alembic current --target remote` = e6f7g8h9i0j1 (head), and `alembic check --target remote` = 'No new upgrade operations detected' — zero drift between models and production. NOTE that this corrects the 20260813-0702 checklist, which asked for that remote check BEFORE opening the PR: impossible, because alembic refuses to compare unless the DB is already at head, so pre-merge it only reports revision lag. It is a POST-deploy check. CD IS ACTIVE — THE OLD MEMORY SAYING IT WAS 'disabled ON PURPOSE' WAS WRONG AND HAS BEEN CORRECTED. `gh workflow list --all` shows all five active; CD triggers on workflow_run when CI completes with head_branch == 'main', and secrets.BACKEND_REMOTE_ENV_FILE is set, so migrate-backend runs `alembic upgrade head` against Supabase with NO human step. ANY merge to main migrates PROD and redeploys. The trap: on a PR the `Detect Deployment Scope` job shows `skipping`, which reads like proof nothing will deploy — it is only the branch guard and stops applying the instant the branch becomes main. This was surfaced to the user and explicitly confirmed BEFORE merging. SECURITY: a plaintext PRODUCTION admin password was found in this PUBLIC repo (.claude/PRPs/plans/completed/region-migration-frankfurt-phase1-2.plan.md, once as ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD and once in a working curl login example), readable since PR #65. ROTATED and verified by reading the stored hash back (new accepted, old rejected). The new value is ONLY in the untracked secrets/secret-keys.txt as JSK_PROD_ADMIN_PASSWORD — NEVER quote it in a tracked file. No history rewrite was done: on a public repo the old value is permanently compromised, so rotation is the remedy. THREE GOTCHAS that each nearly made the rotation a silent no-op and will bite anyone touching --target remote: (1) app/core/config.py:217 runs enforce_production_guards() at IMPORT time and backend/.env sets DEV_AUTH_BYPASS, so scripts abort — pass DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=false, os.environ beats the dotenv file and this is stricter not laxer; (2) settings.DATABASE_URL is a PostgresDsn not a str, so .replace() raises AttributeError — this silently killed the same safety check during an earlier local seed because that script lacked `set -e`, and what actually confirmed the target was seed_admin's own printed header; (3) seed_admin.py only updates a user literally named 'admin' — otherwise it prints 'Another admin user already exists, skipping' and rotates NOTHING while still exiting 0. A full tracked-file scan found nothing else: no API keys, JWTs, private keys or cloud credentials, and no .env has ever been committed; admin1234 is fixture data in backend/tests/test_auth_login.py asserted to FAIL. PROD CLEANUP: test_deactivated (id=4, ADMIN, inactive) was DELETED after discovering all 23 FKs pointing at users.id from information_schema (not hardcoded) and counting zero referencing rows; the script was written to stop rather than delete if the account owned data or was active. REVIEW BEFORE MERGE produced three fixture follow-ups, all applied: cleanup scoped to TARGET instead of deleting every booking with the test service type; a Race NamedTuple replacing a tuple needing nested unpacking that discarded two names; try/finally around teardown so a cleanup failure cannot leak the engine pool. The negative control was RE-RUN after that refactor and still bites — removing pg_advisory_xact_lock fails the same two tests, one reporting two bookings holding the same queue number. MERGE MECHANICS worth knowing: main had moved 11 commits ahead and merging it produced conflicts ONLY in .agents/ handoff state, never in code — TASK_LOG.md and SESSION_INDEX.md are generated so they were regenerated with gen-handoff-views.cjs from the merged checkpoint set rather than hand-edited, and the other two were merged entry by entry keeping both sides. `gh pr merge` succeeded on GitHub but failed to update the local checkout, leaving the tree on a stale local main; before `reset --hard` the one local-only commit (3a479ad) was checked file by file against origin/main and confirmed present inside the squash, so nothing was lost. A stale zero-byte .git/index.lock from an interrupted command blocked a commit and was removed only after confirming no git process was running. TESTS: backend 943 passed / 0 failed after merging main, booking concurrency 4 passed, CI green on #189. STILL OPEN: manual LINE test needs a LIFF ID from the LINE console, and citizens cannot reach /liff/booking because the rich-menu entry is deliberately not built; the admin password should move from secrets/secret-keys.txt into a password manager; Redis still cannot be installed in WSL (no gcc, apt needs the sudo password) so the 60 live-chat/websocket tests stay CI-only — nothing is unverified, CI ran them green on #189.
